bagPolicy.summary: Bags are allowed but all are searched at entry. The FAQ publishes no fixed size or clear-bag requirement.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue validates parking at the 1000 Van Ness Garage at Polk and O’Farrell Streets, about half a block away. Confirm the garage closing time with its attendants.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ does not give a designated rideshare pickup or drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Outside food and beverages cannot be brought inside. The FAQ does not describe the food or drink selection sold at the venue.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Email the venue or call its box office during business hours to arrange an ADA accommodation for a show.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue FAQ does not state a rule for leaving and returning during a show.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets can be purchased on the venue site or fee-free at its box office; a purchased PDF ticket can be forwarded or printed. Box office hours are Friday noon–5 p.m. and show nights beginning two hours before doors.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Show-night box office service begins two hours before the listed door time; the calendar specifies doors for each show. All bags are searched at entry.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
